articles.title: Man shot to death by ICE agent in southern Maine
articles.summary: A Colombian man was fatally shot by an ICE agent this morning in Biddeford, Maine. Sen. Angus King says he was told the man had "weaponized" his vehicle when the shooting occurred.

articles.title: Residents of historic North Nashville see redistricting as a new attempt at division
articles.summary: The redistricting carried out by Tennessee lawmakers divides a community of Black voters along the same line as highway split them up 60 years ago and they say it weakens their power once again.

articles.title: Houston community holds vigil for man killed by ICE agents
articles.summary: A mix of grief and outrage was on display over the weekend at a vigil for Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, who was fatally shot in Houston by ICE agents.

articles.title: A guard punched him on camera. It was still nearly impossible for him to sue
articles.summary: Prisoners are allowed to file complaints about mistreatment — but doing so often comes with retaliation. That's according to an investigation by NPR and The Marshall Project.

articles.title: He was having a mental health crisis. Memphis task force agents came and shot him
articles.summary: Jonah Neal, 25, was struck by a Homeland Security Investigations agent in May. There have been at least four deadly shootings related to the task force.

articles.title: Red Cross declares national blood emergency as supplies dwindle and demand surges
articles.summary: The American Red Cross is declaring a national blood emergency because blood supplies fell 25% in June and demand for blood surged.

articles.title: Want to own a real T. rex? It could cost you $30 million
articles.summary: The Tyrannosaurus rex fossil known as "Gus" will go up for auction on Tuesday. It's not the first time dinosaur bones have been sold to the highest bidder.

articles.title: Georgia's unique in the American Revolution told through its historical markers
articles.summary: NPR's Don Gonyea speaks with Andrew Iden, Executive Producer of Marked!: The Podcast, which examines Georgia's role in America's revolutionary period through the 2,000 roadside historical marker.

articles.title: Airline consolidation now rules the skies. Has it been good for passengers?
articles.summary: The four biggest U.S. airlines control an unprecedented 75% of the market. The industry's critics say consolidation is bad for passengers, but the airlines insist there's still healthy competition.

articles.title: MIDWEST JUDGES TOUR
articles.summary: A group of state and federal judges are touring three states, going to courthouses and schools to talk to Americans about the rule of law.

articles.title: Canadian fashion mogul Peter Nygard pleads guilty in Quebec sex assault case
articles.summary: Canadian fashion mogul Peter Nygard has pleaded guilty to sexual assault and forcible confinement in Quebec

articles.title: More than 53,000 immigrants have been deported or repatriated by South Africa in a crackdown
articles.summary: South African officials say they have deported or repatriated more than 53,000 immigrants in a month in a crackdown on illegal migration

articles.title: Police briefly detain Boris Nadezhdin, a liberal Russian politician and Putin critic
articles.summary: Russian politician Boris Nadezhdin, known for opposing Moscow's military actions in Ukraine, was briefly detained by police on Monday

articles.title: Hungary passes constitutional amendment to remove Orbán-era president
articles.summary: Hungary's Parliament has passed a constitutional amendment aimed at removing the president, seen as a loyalist of former Prime Minister Viktor Orbán

articles.title: EU rallies dozens of nations to pledge $1 billion for recovery fund in Gaza
articles.summary: The European Union has coordinated efforts to raise 900 million euros in aid for Gaza

articles.title: Dozens at Ebola treatment center in northeast Congo strike over unpaid salaries
articles.summary: Dozens of workers at an Ebola treatment center in northeast Congo have gone on strike over unpaid salaries and bonuses

articles.title: UK Police rearrest the suspect in Ann Widdecombe killing on terrorism suspicion
articles.summary: UK police say a 28-year-old man arrested on suspicion of killing former British politician Ann Widdecombe is now suspected of terrorism

articles.title: Former Spanish leader is criticized for comments about France's World Cup team
articles.summary: Former Spanish Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy is facing backlash for comments about France's World Cup team ahead of their match

articles.title: South Korean court sentences ousted President Yoon to 2 years over manipulated opinion polls
articles.summary: A South Korean court has sentenced ousted President Yoon Suk Yeol to two years in prison for illegally receiving manipulated opinion polls for free from a political broker, potentially aiding his 2022 presidential bid

articles.title: UK says Iran-backed group Jewish community attacks, bans Revolutionary Guard
articles.summary: The U.K. government says a proxy group backed by Iran is responsible for recent arson and vandalism attacks on Jewish sites in Britain
